scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of the default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false), not the author's working copy. Python Flask server in server/ scanned fully. ESP32 firmware (C++/PlatformIO, firmware/) , shell scripts (deploy.sh, setup_database.sh), SQL schema and the systemd unit were scanned for secrets, config and obvious hosts only; full interface/data-access detection for C++, shell and SQL is out of scope for skill version 1.0. Web routes with auth_detected=true are tagged low with a note (CSRF/lockout observations) so counts stay literal; extra key interfaces.debug_mode_findings was added for the Flask debug finding. README says the server is 'Planned' while server code exists in the repo (documentation lag). Docs (.md), HTML templates and generated files excluded.

what_this_app_can_do: Accepts temperature/humidity/pressure readings from ESP32 devices over HTTP and stores them in MariaDB; unknown devices self-register and wait for approval.
Lets anyone who can reach the server approve, edit or delete devices through /api/devices endpoints with no login.
Returns the full device inventory (IP and MAC addresses, names, locations) and recent readings to any unauthenticated caller.
Provides a login-protected web dashboard where admins approve, rename, delete devices, regenerate API keys and edit location/notes.
Distributes ESP32 firmware over HTTP (OTA) to any caller who knows a version string; no signature or checksum handling seen.

data_sources_touched.source: MariaDB localfeather database (users, devices, readings, firmware, updates)

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Bound to 0.0.0.0:5000 over plain HTTP, so reachable by anyone on the network (or internet if forwarded). The web UI requires login, but the device-management API, readings list and OTA endpoints have no authentication.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: POST /api/devices/<id>/approve and DELETE /api/devices/<id> have no authentication (code comments say auth to be added)
GET /api/devices exposes IP and MAC addresses and locations without login
Default Flask SECRET_KEY fallback and admin123/viewer123 seed credentials
OTA firmware download is unauthenticated and no integrity verification is visible
No CSRF protection or TLS found
